name: jp.torinos.tweeq-uitoolkit
description: Parameter-tuning GUI widgets for UI Toolkit - a Unity port of Tweeq by Baku Hashimoto. Drag-to-tweak inputs (number, rotary, vector, color, time, ...), parameter layout, popovers/modals/tabs, a timeline viewport, and Radix-scale theming.

samples.description: Lays out tweeq widgets with UXML and USS only. TweeqRoot distributes the theme generated from --tq-* custom properties.
